name: neokki
description: Write, check and study your Neokki flashcard decks from a JavaScript REPL.

interface.longDescription: Neokki keeps your flashcards as text: a deck is a .neodeck file, and cards are HTML that can run JavaScript. This plugin signs in to your Neokki account and gives the agent a JavaScript REPL over your decks, to write and check them, edit them in bulk, and study with you card by card while Neokki schedules each one.
defaultPrompt: Make me a Neokki deck of the 20 most common Spanish verbs
Quiz me on my Capitals deck in Neokki
